eval_script:
# install in: server
set -e
cd /work
git checkout -q -f d8ec697dd896cbe94efab060b28a86736d053efc
git clean -fdq
git apply --whitespace=nowarn /patches/test.diff
git apply --whitespace=nowarn /patches/fix.diff
cd /work/server
if ! { pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install pytest; } > /patches/install.log 2>&1; then
  cat /patches/install.log
  echo "[hecate] install failed" >&2
  exit 97
fi
cat /patches/install.log
mkdir -p /patches/reports
export REPORT_DIR=/patches/reports
cd /work/server
PYTHONPATH=/patches REPORT=$REPORT_DIR/pytest-0.json python -m pytest -p hecate_pytest_reporter -p no:cacheprovider --continue-on-collection-errors || true

install_steps.command: pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install pytest

test_steps.command: PYTHONPATH=/patches REPORT=$REPORT_DIR/pytest-0.json python -m pytest -p hecate_pytest_reporter -p no:cacheprovider --continue-on-collection-errors
